title: Context and memory in the makerspace assistant

items.stem: On Monday, Sam tells your assistant, "I always use the small printer." On Friday the program starts a new session and sends the model only Sam's new message: "Book my usual printer." What must have happened for the model to book the right one?

options.text: The model remembered Monday's chat because it was trained on it
The window was large enough to hold all of last week's chat
A saved note from Monday was loaded into Friday's call
The model guessed from the printers that are usually booked

items.stem: A loop has three model calls. Call 1 receives the system prompt and question, 700 tokens in all, and asks for tool A. The program runs tool A, whose result is 300 tokens; call 2 asks for tool B, whose result is 500 tokens; call 3 writes the final answer. Each tool request is 50 tokens, and every call re-sends everything before it. How many input tokens are sent across the three calls in total?
A student types, "The display says error F-17. What do I do?" The code F-17 appears word for word in the machine's manual. Which search for the right chunk is the safest choice here?

options.text: Embedding search, since it always beats exact word matching
Keyword search, since the exact code is in the manual
No search, and paste the whole manual into every call
No search, and let the model recall the code itself

items.stem: In one or two sentences: why does the search tool return only the few best chunks of a manual instead of the whole manual?
A teammate says, "Let's pick a model with a huge context window, then we won't need saved notes." In one or two sentences, give one reason this does not give the assistant memory between visits.
